info.name: Unified Communication Backend API
info.description: Comprehensive Postman collection for the Unified Communication Backend platform, covering Authentication, Multi-Tenant Management, Users, Telephony Assignments (Extension, DID, FaxBox, VoicemailBox), Communications (Calls, Voicemail, Fax, CDR), Inbound Webhooks, and Audit Logs.

request.description: Authenticates user and automatically stores access and refresh tokens into collection variables.

item.name: List Tenants
item.description: Lists all tenants with live resource counts (extensions_count, dids_count, users_count). Restricted exclusively to Superadmin.

item.name: Create User (Unified: User + Ext + DIDs + Fax + VM)
item.description: Unified API: Creates user and atomically assigns Extension, DIDs, FaxBoxes, and VoicemailBoxes in one call.

item.name: Update User (Unified: User + Ext + DIDs + Fax + VM)
item.description: Unified API: Atomically updates user profile and/or replaces Extension, DIDs, FaxBoxes, and VoicemailBoxes in one call.

request.description: Secure in-memory retrieval of SIP registration credentials for the client softphone (Electron / WebRTC).

item.name: Delete User
item.description: Permanently deletes the user and safely unassigns all attached extensions, DIDs, and boxes.

item.name: List Extensions

query.description: Required for superadmin (can be UUID or code)
Search by number or SIP username

request.description: Lists extensions filtered by tenant or assignment status.

item.description: Lists extensions. For superadmins, tenant_id is strictly required (?tenant_id={{tenantId}} or X-Tenant-ID: {{tenantId}}). Automatically scopes for tenant admin.

item.name: List DIDs

query.description: Required for superadmin (can be UUID or code)

request.description: Lists DIDs with assigned users and capabilities.

item.description: Lists DIDs. For superadmins, tenant_id is strictly required (?tenant_id={{tenantId}} or X-Tenant-ID: {{tenantId}}). Automatically scopes for tenant admin.
